shortDescription: Manage storage in PVE clusters and nodes

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: cephfs_options
options.description: Extended information for adding CephFS storage.

options.name: cifs_options
options.description: Extended information for adding CIFS storage.

options.name: content
options.description: The content types that can be stored on this storage. V(backup) VM backups. V(images) VM disk images. V(import) VM disk images for import. V(iso) ISO images. V(rootdir) container root directories. V(snippets) cloud-init, hook scripts, etc. V(vztmpl) container templates.

options.name: dir_options
options.description: Extended information for adding Directory storage.

options.name: iscsi_options
options.description: Extended information for adding iSCSI storage.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the storage displayed in the storage list.

options.name: nfs_options
options.description: Extended information for adding NFS storage.

options.name: nodes
options.description: A list of nodes where this storage is available. Required when C(state=present).

options.name: pbs_options
options.description: Extended information for adding Proxmox Backup Server as storage.

options.name: rbd_options
options.description: Extended information for adding RBD storage.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the defined storage type to perform.

options.name: type
options.description: The storage type/protocol to use when adding the storage.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).

options.name: zfspool_options
options.description: Extended information for adding ZFS storage.
